name: Tazta
source:
A young man living in Village Gilde. 

Though young, he is independent and proud of this. There is nothing he despises more than being treated like a child. 

While looking for his sister that he lost contact with in the old capital, he falls for LALIELA the instant he sees her and joins up with SUI and company, deciding to journey with them.

[Taken from Hirameki International]
